title: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child puts ki-/ch- nouns in KI-VI (kitabu, chakula) and ji-/ø nouns with a ma- plural in LI-YA (jiwe, gari), and agrees every word.
steps: Find the noun and its plural.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Chumba ni kisafi" and "Vyumba ni visafi".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ni cha ngeli gani?" Kwa nini "LI-YA" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitabu ni cha ngeli ya KI-VI; wingi wake ni vitabu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jiwe ni la ngeli gani?" Kwa nini "KI-VI" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jiwe ni la ngeli ya LI-YA; wingi wake ni mawe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Kitabu kimeanguka na vitabu limeanguka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: KI-VI: ki-, vi-. LI-YA: li-, ya-.
